segments.text: Getting money and keeping money are two completely different skills. Most people only ever learn the first one.
Getting rich takes optimism and risk. Staying rich takes the opposite. Fear, humility, a little paranoia.
The list of people who got rich and then lost it all is long. Great at getting. Terrible at keeping.
Survival is the whole game. You can't win the long one if you get forced out of it.
Getting it and keeping it aren't the same. Honest verdict on the channel.
